name: proofrun
title: ProofRun
one_liner: Find local businesses with weak websites, prove it, rebuild the page, test the rebuild, and draft the outreach.
description: The flagship skill. Takes a niche and a city, discovers candidate businesses, audits their sites against a fixed automated check suite, writes a replacement page as real HTML/CSS, runs that page headlessly against the same checks, repairs it on failure up to a retry cap, and drafts a personalized outreach email citing only verified findings. A human approves everything; nothing is ever sent.

count.description: How many prospects to carry through the loop.

mode.description: demo replays the seeded sample prospect and never calls Tavily.

guarantees: No email is ever sent. Approved drafts are exported, not delivered.
Every audit finding carries a confidence level and names its evidence source.
The before and after scores come from the same check code at the same viewports.
If verification still fails at the retry cap, the run is reported as failed. There is no fake pass.
